opening: I am applying for the Project Operations Coordinator role. My experience coordinating delivery teams and improving request routing fits your need for dependable handoffs and clear operational reporting.
paragraphs: Coordinated weekly handoffs across four delivery teams; overdue handoffs fell 18% over two quarters. Rebuilt an office workflow for intake requests, cutting average routing time from three days to one.
Built an Excel report covering 1,200 monthly requests, helping supervisors identify recurring service delays.
closing: I would welcome a discussion about your coordination needs and the service reporting work described in the posting. Thank you for considering my application.
